about.title: About Me
about.description: My name is Lucas, I'm 24 years old, I was born in São Paulo, and I currently live in São Bernardo do Campo. I started my journey in technology in 2022, studying Systems Analysis and Development. Since then, I've been working as a front-end developer, passionate about creating intuitive, functional, and pleasant experiences, always looking to learn and grow. Come get to know me better, check out my projects and skills, and feel free to get in touch!

projectsList.title: Note Me - To Do List
projectsList.description: A simple and functional to-do list project, built with React, JavaScript and styled with TailwindCSS. Ideal for practicing React hooks, local storage and URL manipulation with react-router-dom.

projectsList.title: Foco +
projectsList.description: A study dashboard developed with Angular and styled using TailwindCSS. The project aims to help organize study routines while providing daily challenges to improve focus and productivity.

projectsList.title: Professional Portfolio
projectsList.description: My professional portfolio developed with React.js and styled using Material UI. This project showcases my technical skills, professional experience, and latest personal projects as a front-end developer in real work.

projectsList.title: PDF Machine
projectsList.description: Fullstack application for converting DOCX files to PDF, developed with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express and LibreOffice. Upload, processing and download de converted documents quickly, securely and efficiently.
